fact: An award notice dated 17 July 2026 from the national coordinator of the MINEPAT Adaptive Social Safety Nets and Economic Inclusion Project (PFS-AIE) awards framework contracts to Mmockmbie Credit Union (zone 1) and People Finance SA (zone 3) for digital payments to project beneficiaries, including cycle 8 of the TMO and phases 7 and 8 of the TMU.
